_doc: MATCH-PENDING functions recorded before their /* MATCH-PENDING: <rule>, <reason> */ markers are in src/. tools/rules.py treats each entry like the marker: the function is byte-matched but not matched under the rules. Remove an entry when its marker lands in src/ or the function is fixed.
